name: xxd-panel-204
title_zh: 柔焦光晕里那层褪色记忆，做成一格 204 号画面
tagline_zh: 照片太清晰反而没情绪？它把画面压成柔焦、褪色、边缘发暗的一格，像隔着旧玻璃回看某年夏天。要的是那股说不清的光。
tagline_en: Your photos are too sharp to feel like memory. This renders them soft, faded, vignetted — one panel, like looking.
desc_en: Create Panel 204 raster artwork: Soft-focus Light-memory Vignette. Use when the user invokes xxd-panel-204 or requests this specific visual language.
why_zh: 它锁定一种视觉语言而不是给一堆可调参数：柔焦、光晕、褪色、暗角四件事一起做，风格才不散。
why_en: It locks one visual language instead of exposing sliders: soft focus, bloom, fade and vignette move together, so the style never.
limit_zh: 只出 Panel 204 这一格风格，不接受换色调、换构图、换画幅；要批量套用到整组图或要可调参数面板，它给不了。
limit_en: Only the Panel 204 look — no recolor, recompose or reformat. No batch runs, no adjustable parameter panel; use a generic filter chain for that.
title_en: Soft-focus light-memory vignette, rendered as Panel 204
